Addendum NO.NPSC.ADVT-1/04(VOL-1) dt. 29.04.2025 (CTSE 2025) 
 Published on : 29-04-2025 03:03 pm 
 NAGALAND PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION 
 KOHIMA 
 NO.NPSC.ADVT-1/04(VOL-1) Dated, Kohima, the 29 th 
April, 2025 
 ADDENDUM 
 With reference to the Nagaland Public Service
Commission’s advertisement No.NPSC-1/CTSE-2025 dated 7 th April, 2025
the following Addendum shall be made as given below: 
 Item No.42: a) 1(one) post of Agriculture Officer (Class-I Gazetted)
under Agriculture Department (R eserved for
Indigenous Inhabitants of Nagaland) 
 b) 10(ten) posts of Agriculture Inspector (Class-III Non-Gazetted) under Agriculture Department { 6 posts reserved
for Indigenous Inhabitants of Nagaland, 2 posts reserved for B.T.Konyak & 1
post each reserved for B.T.Phom, B.T.Sangtam, 1 post from category (b) Partially Deaf, shall be reserved for PwBD either from
I.I/B.T.} 
 Essential Educational
qualification: 
 Item No.42(a)&(b): B.Sc Agri. Sc. & above 
 Elective
subjects to be opted and Pay Matrix /level: 
 Item No.

 The reservation for Item No.29: 1(one) post of Agriculture
Inspector (Class-III Non-Gazetted) under Agriculture Department ( Backlog vacancy of 2023-Agri., Allied
& others) for PwBD shall be from category (a) Low Vision either from I.I./B.T. 
 Other terms and conditions of the advertisement remain
the same.
